description: This Java class 'JWTGenerator' provides functionality to generate and sign JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) using different cryptographic algorithms and key pairs, primarily for authentication purposes within the mockserver project.

classes.name: JWTGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and signing JWT tokens with various algorithms and key pairs.

methods.name: generateJWT
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT with standard claims such as subject, audience, issuer, and timestamps.

methods.name: signJWT
methods.description: Signs a JWT with custom claims using the specified asymmetric key and algorithm.
